body: A captured ID token can sign in again (native sign-in) or refresh a session (oauth.reauthenticate-id-token) until it expires; the nonce is client-chosen and accepted tokens are not recorded. Limits today: re-auth only on the linked user's session, only until exp, nonce match when present; docs tell apps to send a fresh nonce and set IDTokenConfig.RequireNonce. Options: (a) server-issued single-use nonces (new challenge route, both operations require one); (b) record a hash of each accepted token as a single-use row until exp (no client change, changes native sign-in). A test pins today's behaviour so the decision flips it. Owner decision.
title: Decide ID-token replay protection for native sign-in and ID-token re-auth
